releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.214: App Share now attaches the original My Diary logo image with the formatted invitation and existing direct APK download link. Existing share chooser, app identity, notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 411: Diary PIN recovery now shows a small × close control only on the new-PIN entry and confirmation screens, after the temporary PIN and recovery name are verified. Tapping × closes the recovery screen; existing PIN verification, recovery state, saved notes, PIN data, locks, and normal unlock flow are preserved.
